bibliographic.title: The Raven Circle
bibliographic.author: Cressida Tseng
bibliographic.description:
NOTE: This game is the second in a duology. You can find the first game in the series here: https://cressidastclaire.itch.io/sweet-magnolias

A short atmospheric horror story about trapped gods, forgotten sins, and the anxiety of exile.

CW: body horror, surreal horror, auditory jumpscares. Vibrating text effects and changing background color may trigger photosensitive epilepsy. Play discretion is advised.

Playing with the sound on is recommended for the best experience.
